decision.observation: The goose is just below the blue-and-white can but its beak points away to the right; holding Ctrl alone did not visibly secure it.
decision.hypothesis: Taking one short step north onto the clear grass beside the can should put the goose's body and beak close enough for a reliable crouched grab.
decision.memory: The boot required extremely close range and Ctrl plus right-click. The can is still unpicked; approach from the clear southeast side of the stump roots.
